notes.title: Weather update #1
notes.notes: This update added procedural generated clouds and of course a bunch of bug fixes.  More weather updates coming in the future!

notes.title: F-104 patch
notes.notes: This patch includes fixes to the F-104 and a new auto assisting targeting system that should make it easier to aim when you get near an enemy.  If any bugs are found please join the discord and report them :)
